name: Zipkin Open-Source Distributed Tracing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source distributed tracing collector, query API and UI with no vendor software subscription or built-in license usage quota.
watch_out: Operate the Zipkin server yourself using Java/Docker and instrument applications. Persistent trace storage may require Cassandra, Elasticsearch or another backend; compute, storage, messaging and network charges are separate. No hosted free tracing service is included.
